title: Preserve full file identities in host and steward checks
summary: Receipt preflight and the steward guard's legacy-agent and source-settings readers retain full-width file and directory identities. Distinct Windows file IDs that exceed JavaScript's safe integer range now refuse replacement instead of comparing equal after rounding. The source-settings reader validates the opened read-only handle before reading, refuses linked or replaced files and bounds reads through that same handle. Handle closure is preserved, and timestamp comparisons retain nanosecond precision.
